entries.title: Matthew 2:1
segments: ¶Now when the birth of Jesus took place in Beth-lehem of Judaea, in the days of Herod the king, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem,

entries.title: Matthew 2:2
segments: Saying, Where is the King of the Jews whose birth has now taken place? We have seen his star in the east and have come to give him worship.

entries.title: Matthew 2:3
segments: And when it came to the ears of Herod the king, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

entries.title: Matthew 2:4
segments: And he got together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, questioning them as to where the birth-place of the Christ would be.

entries.title: Matthew 2:5
segments: And they said to him, In Beth-lehem of Judaea; for so it is said in the writings of the prophet,

entries.title: Matthew 2:6
segments: You Beth-lehem, in the land of Judah, are not the least among the chiefs of Judah: out of you will come a ruler, who will be the keeper of my people Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 2:7
segments: Then Herod sent for the wise men privately, and put questions to them about what time the star had been seen.

entries.title: Matthew 2:8
segments: And he sent them to Beth-lehem and said, Go and make certain where the young child is; and when you have seen him, let me have news of it, so that I may come and give him worship.

entries.title: Matthew 2:9
segments: ¶And after hearing the king, they went on their way; and the star which they saw in the east went before them, till it came to rest over the place where the young child was.

entries.title: Matthew 2:10
segments: And when they saw the star they were full of joy.

entries.title: Matthew 2:11
segments: And they came into the house, and saw the young child with Mary, his mother; and falling down on their faces they gave him worship; and from their store they gave him offerings of gold, perfume, and spices.

entries.title: Matthew 2:12
segments: And it was made clear to them by God in a dream that they were not to go back to Herod; so they went into their country by another way.

entries.title: Matthew 2:13
segments: ¶And when they had gone, an angel of the Lord came to Joseph in a dream, saying, Get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into Egypt, and do not go from there till I give you word; for Herod will be searching for the young child to put him to death.

entries.title: Matthew 2:14
segments: So he took the young child and his mother by night, and went into Egypt;

entries.title: Matthew 2:15
segments: And was there till the death of Herod; so that the word of the Lord through the prophet might come true, Out of Egypt have I sent for my son.

entries.title: Matthew 2:16
segments: ¶Then Herod, when he saw that he had been tricked by the wise men, was very angry; and he sent out, and put to death all the male children in Beth-lehem and in all the parts round about it, from two years old and under, acting on the knowledge which he had got with care from the wise men.

entries.title: Matthew 2:17
segments: Then the word of Jeremiah the prophet came true,

entries.title: Matthew 2:18
segments: In Ramah there was a sound of weeping and great sorrow, Rachel weeping for her children, and she would not be comforted for their loss.

entries.title: Matthew 2:19
segments: ¶But when Herod was dead, an angel of the Lord came in a dream to Joseph in Egypt,

entries.title: Matthew 2:20
segments: Saying, Get up and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel: because they who were attempting to take the young child's life are dead.

entries.title: Matthew 2:21
segments: And he got up, and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 2:22
segments: But when it came to his ears that Archelaus was ruling over Judaea in the place of his father Herod, he was in fear of going there; and God having given him news of the danger in a dream, he went out of the way into the country parts of Galilee.

entries.title: Matthew 2:23
segments: And he came and was living in a town named Nazareth: so that the word of the prophets might come true, He will be named a Nazarene.
